entities.name: Participate via Zoom
entities.details: Members of the public may participate in person or via Zoom at https://zoom.us/j/3054466800. Meeting ID: 3054466800.

entities.name: Raise Hand
entities.details: Members of the public can raise their hand to speak prior to the City Commission taking action, either via Zoom by clicking 'Raise your Hand' or pressing *9 on the phone.

entities.name: Send email to cityclerk@coralgables.com
entities.details: Members of the public may send an email to cityclerk@coralgables.com prior to the meeting to comment on agenda items.
